newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian c. bank issued 62.5 bln Bfr of CDs in week.
newsitem.headline: Belgian c. bank issued 62.5 bln Bfr of CDs in week.

text.p: The Belgian central bank issued 62.48 billion francs worth of certificates of deposit in the week to December 9, it said in Wednesday's weekly statement.
The bank has now a total 168.42 billion francs worth of CDs outstanding with Belgium's 15 primary dealers of state debt.

The CDs -- expiring on December 31, 1998 and with revisable rates -- are issued to neutralise the impact on the money market of a 230 billion franc state debt buyback operation with central bank capital gains from gold sales in the past years.
Capital gains on gold account fell by 62.66 billion francs and now stand at 62.35 billion francs.
